name: swap-by-where
about: Two zones change places, said the long way: each moved to where the other is.
request: a walled town with a market ward, a residential ward, a craftsmen ward and outskirts
revise: move the {A} to where the {B} is now and move the {B} to where the {A} is now

name: swap-by-word
about: Two zones change places, said in one word.
request: a river town with a market ward, a temple ward, a craftsmen ward and docks

name: move-north
about: One zone put north of another; zones away from both stay where they were.
request: a town with a market ward, a temple ward, a residential ward and a craftsmen ward

name: grow
about: One zone made bigger: it grows; only its neighbours give up land.
request: a town with a market ward, a residential ward, a craftsmen ward and outskirts

name: grow-double
about: One zone made twice as big.
request: a town with a market ward, a residential ward, a craftsmen ward and a temple ward

name: shrink
about: One zone made smaller: it shrinks; zones away from it stay as they were.
request: a town with a market ward, a residential ward, a craftsmen ward and outskirts
